notes: Character Line Pack: the wolf's key moments (greeting, listening, thinking, done, welcome, night watch, update) now speak in a natural recorded voice, bundled in the app — works offline.
Voice Studio (new panel): line-pack toggle and tests, device-voice mode, Azure Neural voice slot.
Best-voice picker: free speech now uses the highest-quality voice on the phone (scored), not the first one found — the robot sound is fixed at the root.
Azure Neural slot: add your own Azure Speech region + key in Voice Studio and all free speech turns neural. Key stays on your phone only.
